title: Redirect unauthenticated user from Orders to Login
description: Verifies that an unauthenticated visitor navigating directly to Orders is redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /orders
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Redirect unauthenticated user from Admin to Login
description: Verifies that an unauthenticated visitor navigating directly to Admin is redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Log in with valid credentials and reach the product catalog
description: Verifies that a user can log in with the hardcoded valid credentials and lands on the product catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify product cards are displayed in the product catalog

title: Redirect unauthenticated user to login when opening Orders directly
description: Verifies an unauthenticated visitor who navigates directly to the orders page is redirected to login and can then access order history after logging in.

steps.description: Navigate to /orders
Verify the user lands on the login page
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to view orders
Verify the page heading is "Order History"

title: Log out and get redirected to login
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can log out from the app shell and is redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the logout control in the app bar
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Purchase a product from product details when authenticated
description: Verifies an authenticated user can buy a product from its detail page and sees a purchase success snackbar.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click a product's view-details action from a catalog card
Click the buy action
Verify the snackbar message "Purchase successful!" is visible

title: Authenticated user can purchase a product from the catalog
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can initiate a purchase from the product catalog and sees a purchase success snackbar.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the purchase action on a product card
Verify the exact text "Purchase successful!" is visible

title: Open a product detail page from the catalog
description: Verifies a visitor can open a product detail page from the catalog and see the product details displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a product's view-details action from a catalog card
Verify the product detail view shows a product image and product information (name, category, price, description)

title: Visitor can open a product details page from the catalog and return to catalog
description: Verifies that an unauthenticated visitor can browse the catalog, open a product’s details, and return to the catalog successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the view-details control on a product card
Click the control to return to the product catalog
Verify product cards are displayed in the product catalog

title: Prevent purchase from product details when unauthenticated
description: Verifies an unauthenticated visitor cannot initiate a purchase from the product details page because the buy action is disabled.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a product's view-details action from a catalog card
Verify the buy action is disabled on the product details page

title: Unauthenticated visitor cannot initiate purchase from the catalog
description: Verifies that the purchase action in the product catalog is disabled when the visitor is not authenticated.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the purchase action is disabled on at least one product card

title: View order history after authenticating
description: Verifies an authenticated user can access order history and sees the correct page heading and order card date field.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to view orders
Verify the page heading is "Order History"
Verify at least one order card displays the "Date:" field

title: Return to the catalog from product details
description: Verifies a visitor can return from a product detail view to the product catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a product's view-details action from a catalog card
Click the in-page control to go back to the product catalog
Verify the product catalog grid/list is displayed

title: Show invalid credentials error on failed login
description: Verifies that submitting invalid login credentials shows the exact invalid credentials error message.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill invalid@example.com into the email field
Fill wrongpass into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the exact text "Invalid credentials." is visible

title: Add a new product in the admin UI
description: Verifies an authenticated admin can add a product via the admin form, sees the exact snackbar, and the new product appears in the admin list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the admin page
Fill Test Product A into the product name field
Fill Test Category into the product category field
Fill 19.99 into the product price field
Fill Test description for product A into the product description field
Fill a valid image URL into the product image URL field
Submit the add-product form
Verify the snackbar message "Product added (UI only, not persisted)." is visible
Verify the admin product list includes Test Product A

title: Edit an existing product in the admin UI
description: Verifies an authenticated admin can edit a product and sees the updated product information reflected in the admin list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the admin page
Select an existing product to edit from the admin list
Fill Updated Product Name into the product name field
Save the product changes
Verify the admin product list shows Updated Product Name

title: Delete an existing product in the admin UI
description: Verifies an authenticated admin can delete a product after confirming and the product is removed from the admin list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill example@gmail.com into the email field
Fill 123456789 into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the admin page
Fill Temp Product To Delete into the product name field
Fill Temp Category into the product category field
Fill 9.99 into the product price field
Fill Temporary product for deletion into the product description field
Fill a valid image URL into the product image URL field
Submit the add-product form
Select Temp Product To Delete in the admin list for deletion
Confirm the deletion in the app UI
Verify Temp Product To Delete is not present in the admin product list
